name: Modern Bilingual
author: HTMLy
description: Modern bilingual (LTR/RTL) HTMLy theme with Tailwind CSS, dark mode, Jalali dates, Lucide icons, and full dashboard settings.

settings.name: text_direction
settings.label: Text Direction
settings.info: auto = detect from language (fa/ar/he/ur → RTL). Or force ltr/rtl.

settings.name: jalali_date
settings.label: Jalali Date
settings.info: Force Jalali (Persian) calendar. Auto-enabled when language is fa.

settings.name: persian_digits
settings.label: Persian Digits
settings.info: Convert 0-9 to ۰-۹. Auto-enabled for Persian RTL.

settings.name: default_color_mode
settings.label: Default Color Mode
settings.info: Initial theme before user preference in localStorage.

settings.name: sidebar_position
settings.label: Sidebar Position
settings.info: Logical end/start so it mirrors correctly in RTL.

settings.name: sticky_navbar
settings.label: Sticky Navbar
settings.info: Keep the glassmorphism navbar fixed at the top.

settings.name: reading_progress
settings.label: Reading Progress Bar
settings.info: Show a progress bar while reading a single post.

settings.name: post_card_style
settings.label: Post Card Style
settings.info: Homepage and archive card layout.

settings.name: cta_enable
settings.label: Header CTA Enable
settings.info: Show a call-to-action button in the navbar.

settings.name: cta_text
settings.label: Header CTA Text
settings.info: Button label.

settings.name: cta_url
settings.label: Header CTA URL
settings.info: Button link (absolute or relative).

settings.name: cta_target
settings.label: Header CTA Target
settings.info: Open CTA in same tab or new tab.

settings.name: cta_style
settings.label: Header CTA Style
settings.info: Primary (filled) or outline button.

settings.name: referrer_param
settings.label: Referrer / Affiliate Param
settings.info: Appended to external outbound links, e.g. ref=myblog or utm_source=myblog

settings.name: hero_enable
settings.label: Hero Enable
settings.info: Show hero section on the homepage.

settings.name: hero_title
settings.label: Hero Title
settings.info: Leave empty to use blog title.

settings.name: hero_subtitle
settings.label: Hero Subtitle
settings.info: Leave empty to use blog tagline/description.

settings.name: hero_bg_style
settings.label: Hero Background
settings.info: Visual style for the homepage hero.

settings.name: hero_search
settings.label: Hero Search Bar
settings.info: Show search input inside the hero.

settings.name: frontpage_posts
settings.label: Static Frontpage Posts
settings.info: Show recent posts below a static frontpage.

settings.name: frontpage_posts
settings.label: Static Frontpage Posts
settings.info: Show recent posts below a static frontpage.

settings.name: featured_post
settings.label: Featured Post Block
settings.info: Highlight a featured/pinned post on the homepage.

settings.name: featured_post_url
settings.label: Featured Post URL/Slug
settings.info: Optional: match post URL or slug. Empty = first post.

settings.name: recent_posts
settings.label: Recent Posts Widget
settings.info: Sidebar: recent posts with thumbnails.

settings.name: popular_posts
settings.label: Popular Posts Widget
settings.info: Sidebar: popular posts (requires views counter).

settings.name: category_list
settings.label: Categories Widget
settings.info: Sidebar: category list.

settings.name: tagcloud
settings.label: Tag Cloud Widget
settings.info: Sidebar: tag cloud with counts.

settings.name: archive
settings.label: Archive Widget
settings.info: Sidebar: archive list.

settings.name: author_bio
settings.label: Author Bio Card
settings.info: Show author bio / about card in sidebar.

settings.name: newsletter_widget
settings.label: Newsletter / Promo Widget
settings.info: Show custom HTML promo block in sidebar.

settings.name: newsletter_html
settings.label: Newsletter / Promo HTML
settings.info: Custom HTML for the promo widget (forms, embed, etc.).

settings.name: post_toc
settings.label: Table of Contents
settings.info: Auto-generate TOC from h2/h3 on single posts.

settings.name: post_share
settings.label: Share Buttons
settings.info: Copy link + social share on single posts.

settings.name: post_navigation
settings.label: Post Navigation
settings.info: Previous / next post cards.

settings.name: related_posts
settings.label: Related Posts
settings.info: Related posts grid below article.

settings.name: post_tag
settings.label: Post Tags
settings.info: Show tags on single posts.

settings.name: footer_copyright
settings.label: Footer Copyright Override
settings.info: Optional custom copyright. Empty uses HTMLy copyright().

settings.name: footer_social
settings.label: Footer Social Links
settings.info: Show social icons in the footer.
